text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please stop at the crosswalk! Check left 
and right to make sure no cars are coming! 
Raise your hand and cross slowly—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...No good. At this rate, the children, 
engrossed in chatting with their friends, 
won't give me a second glance."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I need to call out with enough impact that 
people can't help but pay attention!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I have to make sure nobody gets into a 
traffic accident. I will protect the 
children's future! ...All right, let's 
pull it together—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
HAAAAALT! Stop right there! Check 
thoroughly to make sure no cars are 
coming! Alright, now's the time! 
CRRRROOOOSSSSSS!!
